32391: Tsukasa is the classmate of Junichi and is also the class representative of Class 2-A. She is very hard-working, and often takes the jobs that her classmates do not want. Her study habits, looks, and personality are perfect.
32392: She is Junichi's childhood friend who, despite having a big appetite, avidly reads the dieting books in their school library. She is a member of the Tea-Making Society. Riihoko's arc is the 5th in the Anime.
32393: One of Junichi's childhood friends, and is often seen with his other friend Masayoshi. She is unpredictable as she would punch Junichi anytime. She works part-time at a Family Restaurant to support her single mother.
32394: A friend of Miya's. Having studied at an all-girl's school for most of her life, Sae is incredibly shy around men. She is the main female character on the third arc in the anime
32395: A classmate of Miya's. She is part of their school's girl swimming team. She has a younger brother named Ikuo and is very calm in nature, and humble. Her story is the fourth arc of the anime.
32396: A very popular girl in her final year, who has many fans at school. She can be described as picky, innocently insensitive, insecure, forgetful and eccentric. She also has a liking for cute things, especially puppies.
34563: Junichi's best friend since childhood, who has an interest in Japanese idols. He often purchases photo books of them and shares them with Junichi. His family owns a sushi shop of which he plans to inherit.
34564: Junichi Tachibana is the lead male protagonist of the story. He has a hard time opening up to others due to trauma two years ago when his date stood him up on Christmas Eve, leaving him heartbroken. In the anime, he has acrophobia, which is referenced several times.
34565: Junichi's younger sister and who playfully calls her brother, "Nii-ni." She tends to be jealous when her brother is with another girl. She likes meat buns.
34569: Haruka's friend and captain of the girls swim team. She tends to berate Haruka's playful nature.
34570: Junichi's homeroom teacher. She tends to be a serious teacher, but can easily get drunk when she drinks sake.
34841: A friend of Kaoru. She and Junichi once gave her some advice on having a boyfriend.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
36865: Appears in Episode 12. The director of the movie Sae and Junichi go to see as a prize for their participation in the Best Couple contest. His words of motivation push Junichi to declare his love to Sae.
37550: Rihoko Sakurai's good friend in school.
37551: A quiet but very straight forward girl who is a member of the Tea club.
37552: President of the Tea club. Rihoko and Manaka are members too.
120997: Shouichi's childhood friend who was a bit of a prankster in elementary school, but eventually grew into a more calm personality thanks to his elder sister's influence. His grades are top-notch.
121003: The protagonist's only older sister and in class 3-A at Kibito High School. She was last year's Miss Santa. She has the personality of an air-headed idol, and she naturally charms others. Because of that she's very popular at her school.
121036: A "modern day meddling princess." She is always cheerful and is the class idol of class 2-B at Teruhi Higashi High School. She was the runner-up of last year's "Miss Santa Contest," and has an exclusive seat on the terrace. She loves to eat, and is occasionally stubborn.
121038: An "elite girls' high school swimming club member." She is in class 2-D at Sakuragawa Higashi Girls' High School, a high-class school. She is ignorant of the ways of the world. She has always attended a girls' school, so she is jealous of those who go to co-ed schools.
121039: She in class 1-A at Teruhi Higashi High School, and is a member of the public morals committee. She is extremely timid and weak to pressure, so while she is supposed to be cautioning others about public morals, she ends up bundling her thoughts in. She adores her older sister.
121040: The "gloomy public morals committee member" who is in class 2-A at Teruhi Higashi High School. As the chair of the public morals committee, she has the top grades in her year. She hates unreasonable things.
121062: One of Shouichi's gaming buddies. Araki has been a friend of Shouichi's since middle school, and with his bright, dry personality and good looks, he has popularity with the ladies.
180310: A friend of Tooru and Tomoe. Former president of the Home Ec club.
180311: The homeroom teacher for Shouichi's class. She's an English teacher with a very gentle personality.
180313: She is the president of the Home Ec Club after Shiori stepped down.
180314: She is the vice-president of the Home Ec Club.
180315: Tsuneki Hikari's class mate in the "Save Our Scores" class.
